articles.title: Cryptocurrency Regulation Framework Nears Final Vote
articles.summary: Lawmakers prepare a comprehensive bill that aims to bring clearer rules for digital assets without stifling innovation.
articles.content: Lawmakers prepare a comprehensive bill that aims to bring clearer rules for digital assets without stifling innovation. Industry leaders have welcomed the move as a step toward greater mainstream adoption.
articles.author: D. Kwon

articles.title: Mental Health Apps Gain Clinical Validation
articles.summary: Several digital therapy platforms receive formal endorsement after rigorous independent trials demonstrate measurable benefits.
articles.content: Several digital therapy platforms receive formal endorsement after rigorous independent trials demonstrate measurable benefits. Experts say this could expand access to mental health support worldwide.
articles.author: T. Brooks
